title: Windows migration inventory, reproducible workspace restore and Codex handoff
objective: Publish a reviewable migration guide, six-repository snapshot and reproducible restore script plus an explicit Windows Codex handoff, preserving unfinished CORE-002 and private local evidence.
in_scope: Foundation migration guide and sanitized reusable handoff prompt explicitly requested by the owner
Six repository remote/branch/checkpoint manifest and clone/verify script with non-destructive defaults
Separate private local transport archive of MC outputs, Codely history, ignored data and selected configuration; no credentials or private archive in Git
Validate Foundation gates, publish migration branch to GitHub and preserve CORE-002 branch without claiming implementation complete
out_of_scope: No product feature changes, no public API changes, no production deployment or paid provider calls
No implementation resumption or release of the Core/Ops handoff locks
No migration of Codex authentication databases or unrelated projects; no secret values or raw chat histories in Git

direction_exception.authorized_by: Project owner 2026-10-20 explicitly requested Windows migration, organization, GitHub commits/push and handoff prompts.
direction_exception.reason: Cross-repository development environment and handoff documentation under the current F2 direction; Foundation only is writable and no milestone completion is claimed.
